You may find the information you need in the FAQs about the Empress Effects Heavy listed below. How do I set the noise gate on the Empress Effects Heavy for different playing styles? The Empress Effects Heavy offers two noise gate modes: Natural and Aggressive. Natural mode provides a high sensitivity that opens with very small input levels, suitable for all styles from leads to tight rhythms. Aggressive mode provides a hard clamping gate for fast stops. You can adjust the threshold using the side-mounted trim pot. Turning clockwise increases sensitivity (lower threshold), while counter-clockwise decreases it (higher threshold). 0 Why is my Empress Effects Heavy producing no sound when engaged? Ensure that the pedal is not in bypass mode by checking the LEDs; they indicate which channel is active. If both LEDs are unlit, the pedal is in bypass mode. Additionally, verify the output and gain levels, as well as the connections to your amplifier and guitar. 0 How can I adjust the EQ settings to shape my tone on the Empress Effects Heavy? The pedal has high and low frequency controls. The 'hi' controls start around 3 kHz for high frequencies and the 'low' controls start around 80 Hz for low frequencies. You can also adjust the mid frequency with the mid freq switch, and use the weight control to alter the bass response character. The hi and low EQ bands impact both channels. 0 My Empress Effects Heavy feels too bass-heavy, how can I tweak the low-end response? Use the 'weight' control to modify the low-end character. Lower settings offer a tighter bass response helpful for sharp palm-muted riffs. Higher settings add more depth to the bass. Adjust this in concert with the 'low' EQ control to set the overall level of low-end frequencies. 0 What could be causing unexpected power issues with the Empress Effects Heavy? Ensure you are using the correct power supply specifications: 9V DC with a current of 200 mA. Avoid daisy-chaining the power supply to multiple pedals as it may lead to overloading. Inspect the power supply condition and check for any potential damage to the pedal itself. 0 Is the manual of the Empress Effects Heavy available in English?
